title: Kanto Had a Hidden Easy Mode

direction.premise: Kanto hides an early-game easy mode inside the starter many players underestimated.
direction.audiencePromise: Reveal the starter through a two-gym journey, explain its head start, then overturn the easy-mode claim.
direction.openLoop: Was Bulbasaur actually Kanto's hidden easy mode?
direction.payoff: It dominates the opening and evolves fastest, but four weaknesses keep the verdict debatable.
direction.engagementQuestion: Was Bulbasaur easy mode or simply Kanto's smartest design?

voice.instructions: Warm, confident short-form documentary narrator. Natural conversational pace, crisp pronunciation, curious storytelling, and subtle emphasis on key turns. Leave room for the visuals. Never imitate a known person or character.
